Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the neutron has the least mass, using an erroneous neutron mass value and misapplying basic atomic physics. In reality, electrons are far lighter than protons, neutrons, or the nucleus; the neutron is much heavier than an electron. The Planner also prematurely marked the task complete without verification.
